+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_TTS_ENDPOINT = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech"
+OPENAI_TTS_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini-tts"
+
+
+def build_briefing_text(platform_output: Any) -> str:
+    if isinstance(platform_output, str):
+        text = platform_output.strip()
+    else:
+        text = str(platform_output).strip()
+    return text or "No platform output was provided."
+
+
+def generate_spoken_briefing(platform_output: Any, output_path: str, voice: str = "alloy", speed: float = 1.0, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    api_key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "model": OPENAI_TTS_MODEL,
+        "input": build_briefing_text(platform_output),
+        "voice": voice,
+        "speed": speed,
+        "response_format": "mp3",
+    }
+    headers = {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(OPENAI_TTS_ENDPOINT, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=60)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+
+    with open(output_path, "wb") as audio_file:
+        audio_file.write(response.content)
+
+    return output_path
+
*** End Patch

+import os
+from typing import List, Sequence
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL = "text-embedding-3-small"
+
+
+def _client() -> OpenAI:
+    return OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+
+
+def embed_platform_outputs(outputs: Sequence[str]) -> List[List[float]]:
+    if not outputs:
+        return []
+    client = _client()
+    response = client.embeddings.create(model=OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL, input=list(outputs))
+    vectors = [item.embedding for item in response.data]
+    return vectors
+
+
+def embed_platform_output(output: str) -> List[float]:
+    return embed_platform_outputs([output])[0]

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class LocalizationConfig:
+    api_key: str
+    base_url: str
+    model: str
+    target_locale: str
+
+
+def _env(name: str, default: str | None = None) -> str | None:
+    value = os.getenv(name)
+    return value if value not in (None, "") else default
+
+
+def load_config() -> LocalizationConfig:
+    api_key = _env("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    return LocalizationConfig(
+        api_key=api_key,
+        base_url=_env("OPENAI_BASE_URL", "https://api.openai.com/v1") or "https://api.openai.com/v1",
+        model=_env("OPENAI_MODEL", "openai/gpt-5.4-mini") or "openai/gpt-5.4-mini",
+        target_locale=_env("TARGET_LOCALE", "es-ES") or "es-ES",
+    )
+
+
+def localize_platform_output(platform_output: str) -> str:
+    config = load_config()
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=config.api_key, base_url=config.base_url)
+    response = client.chat.completions.create(
+        model=config.model,
+        messages=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": f"Translate the platform output into {config.target_locale}. Preserve meaning, product names, and formatting.",
+            },
+            {"role": "user", "content": platform_output},
+        ],
+        temperature=0,
+    )
+    return response.choices[0].message.content or ""

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
+OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"
+
+
+def check_platform_output_safety(output_text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps({"model": OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL, "input": output_text}),
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    result = response.json()
+
+    assessment = result["results"][0]
+    flagged = bool(assessment.get("flagged", False))
+    categories = assessment.get("categories", {})
+    category_scores = assessment.get("category_scores", {})
+
+    return {
+        "safe": not flagged,
+        "flagged": flagged,
+        "categories": categories,
+        "category_scores": category_scores,
+        "provider": "openai",
+        "model": OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL,
+    }
*** End Patch

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import openai
+
+
+DEFAULT_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL", "openai/gpt-5.4-mini")
+
+
+def _env(name: str, default: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:
+    value = os.getenv(name)
+    return value if value not in (None, "") else default
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ManagedModelConfig:
+    api_key: str
+    base_url: str
+    model: str = DEFAULT_MODEL
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_env(cls) -> "ManagedModelConfig":
+        api_key = _env("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+        if not api_key:
+            raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+        base_url = _env("OPENAI_BASE_URL", "https://api.openai.com/v1")
+        model = _env("OPENAI_MODEL", DEFAULT_MODEL) or DEFAULT_MODEL
+        return cls(api_key=api_key, base_url=base_url, model=model)
+
+
+class ManagedModelClient:
+    def __init__(self, config: Optional[ManagedModelConfig] = None) -> None:
+        self.config = config or ManagedModelConfig.from_env()
+        self._client = openai.OpenAI(api_key=self.config.api_key, base_url=self.config.base_url)
+

+        response = self._client.chat.completions.create(model=self.config.model, messages=messages, **kwargs)
+        return response.choices[0].message.content or ""
+
+    def complete(self, prompt: str, **kwargs: Any) -> str:
+        return self.chat([{"role": "user", "content": prompt}], **kwargs)
+
+    def raw_client(self) -> openai.OpenAI:
+        return self._client
+
+

+    config = ManagedModelConfig.from_env()
+    return {"api_key": config.api_key, "base_url": config.base_url, "model": config.model}
+
+
+def get_client(config: Optional[ManagedModelConfig] = None) -> ManagedModelClient:
+    return ManagedModelClient(config=config)

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Iterator, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def stream_platform_generation(
+    prompt: str,
+    model: str = "gpt-4.1-mini",
+    system: Optional[str] = None,
+    temperature: float = 0.7,
+) -> Iterator[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    messages = []
+    if system is not None:
+        messages.append({"role": "system", "content": system})
+    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})
+    with client.responses.stream(model=model, input=messages, temperature=temperature) as stream:
+        for event in stream:
+            yield {
+                "event": event,
+                "response": getattr(event, "response", None),
+                "type": getattr(event, "type", None),
+            }
+
+
+def collect_stream_text(prompt: str, model: str = "gpt-4.1-mini") -> str:
+    chunks = []
+    for item in stream_platform_generation(prompt=prompt, model=model):
+        event = item["event"]
+        if getattr(event, "type", None) == "response.output_text.delta":
+            delta = getattr(event, "delta", None)
+            if delta:
+                chunks.append(delta)
+    return "".join(chunks)
+
+
+__all__ = ["stream_platform_generation", "collect_stream_text"]
*** End Patch

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PlatformResource:
+    provider: str
+    resource: str
+    kind: str
+
+
+def select_platform_resource(explicit_resource: Optional[str] = None) -> PlatformResource:
+    resource = explicit_resource or os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL") or os.getenv("OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT") or "gpt-5.4-mini"
+    client = OpenAI()
+    if resource.startswith("ft:") or resource.startswith("gpt-") or resource.startswith("openai/"):
+        resolved = resource.replace("openai/", "")
+        return PlatformResource(provider="openai", resource=resolved, kind="model")
+    models = client.models.list()
+    for item in models.data:
+        if getattr(item, "id", None) == resource:
+            return PlatformResource(provider="openai", resource=resource, kind="model")
+    return PlatformResource(provider="openai", resource=resource, kind="deployment")

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PlatformResource:
+    provider: str
+    resource: str
+    kind: str
+
+
+def select_platform_resource(explicit_resource: Optional[str] = None) -> PlatformResource:
+    resource = explicit_resource or os.getenv("OPENAI_MODEL") or os.getenv("OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT") or "gpt-5.4-mini"
+    client = OpenAI()
+    if resource.startswith("ft:") or resource.startswith("gpt-") or resource.startswith("openai/"):
+        resolved = resource.replace("openai/", "")
+        return PlatformResource(provider="openai", resource=resolved, kind="model")
+    models = client.models.list()
+    for item in models.data:
+        if getattr(item, "id", None) == resource:
+            return PlatformResource(provider="openai", resource=resource, kind="model")
+    return PlatformResource(provider="openai", resource=resource, kind="deployment")
